rationale: The reviewer reduces the Liberty Bell to petty inconveniences (eleven-hour drive, Motel 6, security line, 'You can't even ring it!') and insists the landmark's fame is merely an annoyance, defending the one-star verdict with no wink. The few concessions ('staff were nice', 'Two stars for the history') don't undercut the overall total commitment to being wrong.
quote: You can't even ring it! I get WHY, but come on. Eleven hours and I can't hear the one thing a bell is supposed to do.
